name: Set Theory and Real Number System
introduction: Set theory is the foundation of modern mathematics. This chapter covers set operations, Venn diagrams, real number properties, and intervals.
whyItMatters: 2-3 marks per year. Venn diagram problems with three sets and real number properties are most frequently tested.

name: Quadratic Equations and Sequence Series
introduction: This chapter covers quadratic equations, arithmetic and geometric sequences, and series.
whyItMatters: 3-4 marks from this chapter. Focus on sum of series, nature of roots, and GP convergence problems.

name: Matrices and Determinants
introduction: Matrices and determinants form the basis of linear algebra, crucial for engineering applications.
whyItMatters: 3-4 marks. Inverse of 3x3 matrix, Cramer's rule, and matrix properties are key topics.

name: Mechanics
introduction: Mechanics covers Newton's laws of motion, work-energy theorem, and conservation principles.
whyItMatters: 5-6 marks. This is the highest weightage unit in physics. Focus on projectile motion and circular motion.

name: General and Physical Chemistry
introduction: Covers atomic structure, chemical bonding, states of matter, and thermochemistry.
whyItMatters: 4-5 marks. Conceptual questions on bonding and numerical on thermochemistry are common.

name: Sets
introduction: Introduction to sets, set notation, Venn diagrams, and set operations for SEE level.
whyItMatters: Consistent 4 marks in SEE. Master Venn diagram problems for guaranteed scoring.
